requirements.acceptance: Toggling twice restores the initial status.

spec.name: Task management
spec.description: A local productivity app with persistent tasks and deterministic acceptance criteria.

requirements.text: Create a task with a required title. Reject blank titles. For browser acceptance use the accessible input name Task title and button name Add task. On blank submit show an alert containing Enter a task title.
requirements.acceptance: Submitting a blank title shows an error and does not add a task.

requirements.text: Toggle a task between active and complete. Use a checkbox for each task with accessible name Complete followed by the task title.
requirements.acceptance: Toggling twice restores the initial status.

requirements.text: Filter tasks by status and title substring. Use a search input labeled Search tasks and a select labeled Status filter, with all, active, and completed values. When no tasks match, show No tasks match your filters.
requirements.acceptance: Completed filter excludes active tasks and combines with text search.

requirements.text: Persist tasks across reloads using local storage. Use browser localStorage and preserve titles and completion flags on reload.
requirements.acceptance: Reload restores titles and completion state.

requirements.text: Provide keyboard-accessible labeled controls and an empty state. Use a document title, lang attribute, a main landmark, and labeled controls. Add task follows Task title in the tab order.
requirements.acceptance: All task actions are reachable by Tab and empty filters explain the state.

spec.name: Operations Analytics Dashboard
spec.description: Compare synthetic fulfillment and staffing metrics across teams and reporting periods.

requirements.text: Choose a date range and team for the dashboard. Use labeled select controls Team (All teams, North, South) and Reporting period (Jan 1–3, Jan 2), default All teams and Jan 1–3. Dates are January 2025. Option values must equal their visible labels.
requirements.acceptance: Every panel uses the same date range and team.

requirements.text: Validate records against the typed order and staffing contracts. Use this fixed synthetic dataset. Orders are (id, day in January, team, minutes, completed): (N1,1,North,20,true), (N2,2,North,40,false), (N3,2,North,60,true), (S1,2,South,10,true), (S2,3,South,30,false), (X1,2,empty team,15,true), (X2,2,North,-5,true). Staffing hours are (1,North,4), (2,North,5), (2,South,3). Other entries are missing. Report the number of invalid records across the whole input in text using “Excluded records: N”.
requirements.acceptance: Rows with missing team IDs or negative durations are excluded and counted.

requirements.text: Show volume, completion rate, and median turnaround cards. Volume counts valid matching orders. Rate is completed divided by volume as a whole percent. Median uses all valid matching order durations in minutes, including incomplete orders. Include visible text “Volume: N”, “Completion rate: N%”, and “Median turnaround: N min” for nonempty results.
requirements.acceptance: Card totals match the filtered records and zero denominators show an empty value.

requirements.text: Plot daily volume and completion rate. Provide selectable days with accessible buttons named Jan 1, Jan 2, Jan 3 in the full-period chart.
requirements.acceptance: Days without records appear as gaps or explicit zero volume.

requirements.text: Compare staffing hours with completed work by team. Provide an accessible table named Staffing comparison and show team, total staffing hours, and completed order count. Sum the known staffing hours in the selected window and label incomplete totals. Use cell text Staffing hours: N and Completed orders: N.
requirements.acceptance: Changing the reporting period updates both axes and accessible table values.

requirements.text: Open the underlying order table from a chart selection. Expose the filtered results in an accessible table named Orders with the order IDs.
requirements.acceptance: Selecting a day applies its date constraint and preserves the team filter.

requirements.text: Sort and paginate order records.
requirements.acceptance: Sorting applies before pagination and preserves the current filters.

requirements.text: Save a dashboard view locally. Provide a button named Save view and restore the saved view on reload.
requirements.acceptance: Reload restores the saved range, team, and table sort.

requirements.text: Export the filtered table as CSV.
requirements.acceptance: Exported rows match the active filters and have escaped cells.

requirements.text: Explain empty and incomplete results. When a selected team or period has missing staffing entries, include the text “Staffing data incomplete” and keep order KPIs visible.
requirements.acceptance: Missing staffing values show a reason and leave order totals available.

spec.name: Aviation Operations Console
spec.description: Explore a fictional airport operations exercise using entirely synthetic, non-operational data.

requirements.text: Load synthetic flights, stands, turnaround milestones, and simulated alerts. Use the fixed synthetic fixture. Exclude the malformed record and show Invalid records: 1.
requirements.acceptance: Malformed records appear in a data quality summary.

requirements.text: Display the current exercise clock in UTC. Start at 08:00 UTC. Advance 5 min advances one deterministic step unless paused. A Pause exercise button toggles pause.
requirements.acceptance: Pausing the exercise freezes all time-based views.

requirements.text: Filter the exercise by terminal, time range, and flight status. Expose Terminal, Time range, and Flight status as labeled select controls. Values equal their labels. Defaults are All terminals, Full exercise, and All statuses. Also offer T1, T2, 08:30–09:30 UTC, On time, and Delayed as applicable.
requirements.acceptance: The board, stand view, and alert list reflect the selected scope.

requirements.text: Show arrivals and departures on a sortable flight board. Expose a table named Flight board and visible Board order: followed by the displayed IDs separated by comma and space. Sort schedule ascending by default, using flight ID for ties.
requirements.acceptance: Sort order uses scheduled UTC time with a stable flight ID tie-breaker.

requirements.text: Open a flight detail panel from the board. Use a button with the exact flight ID to open the Flight detail region.
requirements.acceptance: The panel shows synthetic movement, stand, milestone, and alert references.

requirements.text: Visualize stand assignments across the selected period. Use a Stand assignments region. Show each matching flight, its stand, and interval.
requirements.acceptance: Overlapping assignments render as separate blocks and list the affected flight IDs.

requirements.text: Flag conflicting stand assignments. Use a Stand conflicts region. Treat intervals as half-open. Show Conflict: A02 · AX101 / AX102 for the one overlapping pair. Adjacent intervals are allowed.
requirements.acceptance: Two occupied intervals that overlap trigger a single conflict per flight pair.

requirements.text: Track turnaround milestones and simulated delay reasons. Show Milestone: Unknown in the detail panel for AX101. Keep missing milestones out of the completion numerator.
requirements.acceptance: A missing milestone is labeled unknown and excluded from completion totals.

requirements.text: Display simulated alert priorities and sources. Use a Simulated alerts region. Keep IDs and priority visible.
requirements.acceptance: Alerts preserve their fictional event IDs and link to affected flight or stand records.

requirements.text: Acknowledge an exercise alert locally. Use a button named Acknowledge SIM-101. After clicking it, show Acknowledged at 08:05 UTC if the exercise is at 08:05.
requirements.acceptance: Acknowledging one alert updates its state while retaining its original event and priority.

requirements.text: Record local acknowledgement history. Restore acknowledgement and exercise timestamp from local storage on reload.
requirements.acceptance: Reload restores acknowledgements and the exercise timestamps.

requirements.text: Show aggregate activity and stand utilization. Use Flights in scope: N and Stand conflicts: N for the current filtered counts.
requirements.acceptance: Totals match filtered exercise records and identify incomplete data.

requirements.text: Provide keyboard navigation and readable status labels.
requirements.acceptance: Every view is reachable by keyboard and no status depends on color alone.

requirements.text: Export a synthetic exercise summary. Prepare summary renders a readable local Exercise summary region containing the exercise-only label, filters, flight and alert source IDs, and alert counts. Export JSON can download that same report.
requirements.acceptance: The export includes filters, source IDs, alert counts, and the exercise-only label.

requirements.text: Reset the exercise and clear local adjustments. Use a Reset exercise button that clears exercise state and restores 08:00 UTC and all default filters.
requirements.acceptance: Reset restores the initial synthetic snapshot and default scope.

requirements.text: Label every view as a synthetic exercise. Show the exact visible text Synthetic exercise · Non-operational on the main view and summary.
requirements.acceptance: The label remains visible on narrow layouts and is included in exports.
